title: Senior Manager, SoFi Plus Member Acquisition
description: Employee Applicant Privacy Notice Who we are: Shape a brighter financial future with us. Together with our members, we’re changing the way people think about and interact with personal finance. We’re a next-generation financial services company and national bank using innovative, mobile-first technology to help our millions of members reach their goals. The industry is going through an unprecedented transformation, and we’re at the forefront. We’re proud to come to work every day knowing that what we do has a direct impact on people’s lives, with our core values guiding us every step of the way. Join us to invest in yourself, your career, and the financial world. We are seeking a Senior Manager, SoFi Plus Growth to help accelerate membership growth for SoFi Plus within the Member Business Unit. This role will focus on overall funnel optimization, sizing addressable market opportunities, leading the development of member signup experiences across teams, and tracking all placement performance. Success in this role will directly support our ambition to serve millions of SoFi Plus members with the best financial services subscription in the world. The role will be directly responsible for identifying high-leverage in-product placements, analyzing opportunities within the funnel, and determining how best to address segment growth. They will build the measurement framework to track impression coverage and performance, along with optimization targets. A key aspect of this role is acting as a full-stack operator who can partner with other business units, using data to build compelling business cases to integrate SoFi Plus across the member experience. This is a highly analytical and cross-functional role for someone who can translate data into insights that create growth, drive alignment across teams, and create clear executive-ready updates.   What you'll do:   Opportunity Sizing & Segmentation: Own addressable market opportunity sizing and segment definitions by population and placement type. Performance Reporting: Own all-up placement and impression performance, including performance readouts, insight generation, and recommendations for optimization. Measurement Frameworks: Build and maintain reporting on reach, impression coverage, placement performance, and incremental improvements over time. Funnel Analysis: Analyze opportunities and drop-offs throughout the product funnel, ensuring new placements connect eligible members to SoFi Plus seamlessly. Ecosystem Placement Strategy: Own the overall placement and funnel optimization strategy, driving the execution roadmap for SoFi Plus member growth across the member ecosystem. Traffic & Business Forecasting: Collaborate with Product, Marketing, and Data teams to forecast direct traffic, model adoption rates, and project the downstream business impact of new placements. Launch Program Management: Track launch timelines for placements highlighting cross-functional dependencies, risks, blockers, and readiness gaps. Cross-Business Partnership: Partner with leads in other business units to build compelling, data-backed cases to incorporate Plus in order to lift their own core metrics. Risk & Growth Alignment: Partner with Risk leaders on how to safely execute against our growth vision, carefully balancing aggressive expansion with financial, fraud, and operational risk concerns. Executive Communication: Lead executive updates, readiness reviews, and stakeholder communications related to SoFi Plus growth priorities and progress. Operational Excellence: Create operating mechanisms that improve transparency, accountability, and decision-making across workstreams. What you'll need: 10+ years of relevant experience in product management, product strategy, portfolio management, growth, analytics, marketing strategy, or a related field. Demonstrated experience using data to size opportunities, prioritize growth initiatives, and influence product or business decisions. Strong analytical skills, including comfort working with large datasets, funnel metrics, segmentation, experimentation, and performance reporting – especially through the use of AI-powered tooling. Experience defining addressable audiences, channel opportunities, growth levers, and measurement frameworks. Proven ability to lead cross-functional initiatives and influence in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment without relying on formal authority. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with experience preparing executive-level updates, business reviews, and decision materials. Strong program-management discipline, including the ability to manage timelines, dependencies, risks, readiness reviews, and stakeholder accountability. Ability to connect strategic priorities with operational execution and measurable business outcomes. High ownership mindset, strong judgment, and willingness to roll up your sleeves to get work done. title: Technical Success Manager
description: About Zscaler Zscaler accelerates digital transformation to ensure our customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. As an AI-forward enterprise , we are constantly pushing the envelope, leveraging the world’s largest security data lake to power our cloud-native Zero Trust Exchange platform. This innovation protects our customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Here, impact in your role matters more than title and trust is built on results. We say, impact over activity. We seek innovators who actively use AI to amplify their impact and who thrive in an environment where we leverage intelligent systems to stay ahead of evolving threats. We believe in transparency and value constructive, honest debate —we’re focused on getting to the best ideas, faster. We build high-performing teams that can make an impact quickly and with high quality. To do this, we are building a culture of execution centered on customer obsession , collaboration, ownership, and accountability. We value high-impact, high-accountability with a sense of urgency where you’re enabled to do your best work and embrace your potential. If you’re driven by purpose, thrive on solving complex challenges, and want to be part of the team that’s helping to secure the AI age, we invite you to bring your talents to Zscaler and help shape the future of cybersecurity. Role We are looking for a SecOps Technical Success Manager to join our team. This is a Remote role, reporting to the Senior Manager, Technical Success in the Technical Success department. The SecOps Technical Success Manager empowers our customers to continuously improve their security outcomes, driving satisfaction, retention, and strategic growth. Serving as a trusted advisor, you will build deep customer relationships, guide clients through onboarding to renewal, and help security teams maximize the value of their investment in Zscaler SecOps products. What you’ll do (Role Expectations) Lead end-to-end post-sales customer engagements from onboarding through renewal, ensuring maximum value realization across Zscaler SecOps solutions including Zscaler MDR (Red Canary) Provide ongoing education, share security best practices, and deliver strategic guidance to help customers achieve their cybersecurity goals Partner closely with Sales to manage renewals, mitigate retention risk, and identify opportunities for account expansion, upsell, and cross-sell Conduct regular executive business reviews and champion customer needs internally with technical, product, and sales teams Maintain deep domain expertise in Zscaler SecOps products and roadmap, gathering customer feedback to directly inform future product development Who You Are (Success Profile) You are customer-obsessed, building deep empathy for security teams and anchoring your decisions in solving their real-world outcomes. You are a high-trust collaborator, partnering seamlessly across Sales, Support, and Product teams to champion customer needs. You are a natural problem-solver, energized by distilling complex technical challenges into clear, actionable recommendations. You operate with urgency, driving fast, high-impact execution to secure renewals and help customers realize immediate value. You are data-driven, leveraging analytics and customer metrics to surface key insights, evaluate risks, and guide strategic decisions. What We’re Looking for (Minimum Qualifications) Demonstrated experience integrating generative AI tools into your daily workflow to increase productivity, scale customer interactions, and solve problems faster 3+ years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, Technical Account Management, or a similar client-facing role at a SaaS cybersecurity company 2+ years managing a book of business comprised of 25-30 customers with an average ARR of $200,000+ Solid understanding of cybersecurity concepts and technologies, including endpoint security, network security, cloud security, SIEM, threat intelligence, incident response, and MDR/XDR Strong data analysis skills to review customer performance metrics, identify trends, and deliver actionable security insights and recommendations What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications) Prior experience using Red Canary or other Managed Detection and Response (MDR) solutions, alongside expertise in SOC operations, vulnerability management, and deception technologies Deep understanding of networking and cloud concepts, paired with industry certifications or advanced degrees in Cybersecurity, Customer Success, Project Management, or Data Analytics Demonstrated capability using CRM platforms such as Salesforce to manage client accounts, track retention risks, and capture expansion opportunities #LI-Remote #LI-IA1 Zscaler’s salary ranges are benchmarked and are determined by role and level.
